$comment: Safety policy for the public library. The compiler and validator enforce this file; nothing reaches the image backend if a check fails. Negative prompts reduce risk but do not guarantee it, so the image check + human approval in docs/safety.md are the real gate before publishing.
$comment_child_terms: Words like 'beautiful' and 'pose' are harmless for adults but are blocked for children because they are the words people use to steer images of children somewhere they must not go.
positive_all: fully clothed, modest clothing, natural documentary photo
positive_child: child, fully covered age-appropriate clothing, with family, everyday ordinary moment, documentary photo
negative_base: cartoon, 3d render, cgi, illustration, painting, plastic skin, airbrushed, over-smoothed skin, distorted face, extra fingers, deformed hands, watermark, text, logo
negative_safety_all: nsfw, nude, nudity, naked, topless, cleavage, lingerie, underwear, swimsuit, bikini, see-through clothing, revealing clothing, sexual, suggestive, erotic, sexy pose, seductive, provocative, glamour, celebrity likeness
negative_safety_child: makeup, lipstick, jewellery overload, adult clothing, revealing clothing, bare shoulders, bare legs, crop top, shorts, swimsuit, posing, model pose, fashion shoot, glamour, romantic, bride, adult proportions, mature face

child_rules.$comment: neutral_portrait is allowed only because children are never published. Jewellery on children is limited to small studs or a simple bangle; the compiler drops anything else.

adult_rules.$comment: Glam content is out of scope for this library.
